summary: Defines a MIB module for the reverse direction of RFC 5675: turning syslog messages into SNMP notifications. A management system can then receive syslog events as SNMP traps. It is a standards-track document.

eli5.summary: This is the translation guide going the other way. A note written in a log diary can be turned into a loud alert message that a network manager's tools already know how to hear.

questions: how to send syslog messages as snmp notifications
